invoice-bot: system: ingest failed: ERR_ROUTING_NO_APPROVER - approver lookup timed out for cost_center 'ENG-NA'.

sarah: I'm OOO until Thu morning. If urgent, route to my backup @chris.
chris: I can be backup. Procurement, can you update PO entity or start supplier change?

galactic-payables: Yes, we'll void and reissue by EOD. New invoice will reference PO-99823 and Redwood Inc.

invoice-bot: ack. Scanner rules: match filename pattern `galactic_*_RWD-01.pdf`. Last attempt failed with `ERR_DUPLICATE_INGEST` due to original filename `galactic_PO-99823.pdf` — vendor should change filename.

chris: Procurement will follow up on supplier entity change to prevent future issues.
mike: Thanks — @galactic-payables please upload corrected invoice named `galactic_PO-99823_RWD-01.pdf` and cc finance@redwood.com.
galactic-payables: Uploaded: s3://vendor-invoices/galactic/galactic_PO-99823_RWD-01.pdf. Please confirm receipt.
invoice-bot: New file detected. Matched to PO-99823. Route sent to approver chris. Status: PENDING_APPROVAL.
sarah: Back online, will step in if needed.
mike: Closing once payment scheduled. Thanks everyone :slightly_smiling_face:
